gloss: to be irritated; to be frustrated

definitions.gloss: to be irritated; to be frustrated; to be on edge
definitions.explanation: to feel annoyed or impatient, often expressed outwardly

examples.japanese: {渋滞|じゅうたい}で{苛立|いらだ}っている。
examples.english: I'm irritated by the traffic jam.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{苛立|いらだ}った{様子|ようす}で{電話|でんわ}を{切|き}った。
examples.english: He hung up the phone in an irritated manner.

examples.japanese: {待|ま}たされて{苛立|いらだ}ちを{感|かん}じた。
examples.english: I felt frustrated from being kept waiting.

notes:
{苛立|いらだ}つ expresses a feeling of irritation or frustration.

VERB TYPE:
- Godan verb (つ-verb)
- Intransitive

KANJI NOTE:
- {苛|いら} means "harsh, cruel" but here expresses irritation
- Often written in hiragana: いらだつ, いら{立|だ}つ

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {苛立|いらだ}った{声|こえ} (irritated voice)
- {苛立|いらだ}った{様子|ようす} (irritated manner)
- {苛立|いらだ}ちを{感|かん}じる (to feel irritation)
- {苛立|いらだ}ちを{隠|かく}せない (unable to hide irritation)

RELATED FORMS:
- {苛立|いらだ}ち (noun: irritation, frustration)
- {苛立|いらだ}たしい (adjective: irritating)

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- イライラする (to be irritated - onomatopoeia, more casual)
- {腹|はら}が{立|た}つ (to get angry - stronger)
- じれったい (frustrating - focus on impatience)
- {焦|あせ}る (to be impatient)

NUANCE:
- Stronger than simple annoyance
- Often visible in behavior or tone
- Can be caused by waiting, inconvenience, or frustrating situations

REGISTER: Neutral. Common in everyday conversation.
